speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano says Ronaldo had warned he would leave if Portugal no longer counted on him, then reports he called his private jet and left the national team camp.
quote: Cristiano Ronaldo, directly from Copenhagen, called his private jet back to get him, to pick him up, and leave the Portuguese national team camp.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano reports that Ronaldo missed training, left Portugal camp, and issued a statement saying he left after the coach’s press conference and would reveal the truth soon.
quote: After the press conference of the coach, I decided to leave the national team camp.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali claims Cristiano Ronaldo has left Portugal and says the Ronaldo era with the national team is over.
quote: Cristiano Ronaldo has officially left the Portuguese national team.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says reports claim Ronaldo left Portugal camp, missed training for a third day, and could retire internationally after problems with Jorge Jesus.
quote: He could retire from international football and bring his Portugal career to an end following the problematic with the manager Jorge Jesus.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: The commentator says Ronaldo should have retired after the World Cup and suggests that his Spain match may have been his final appearance for Portugal.
quote: Probably the last time we saw Cristiano Ronaldo.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano says Ronaldo expected Jorge Jesus to apologize publicly, but after the coach instead stressed his own authority, Ronaldo skipped training, told the federation president it was too much, and left Portugal camp by private jet.
quote: Cristiano tells the president of the federation, "I'm sorry, but this was too much."

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano claims the Portuguese federation tried to calm the situation, but Ronaldo was furious and refused to stay in Copenhagen even one more night.
quote: Cristiano was crazy, crazy, furious all Wednesday night.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali reads a report claiming Cristiano Ronaldo feels betrayed by Jorge Jesus after being warmed up for 30 minutes without playing, leading Ronaldo to leave the Portugal camp amid major tension over his future.
quote: Cristiano Ronaldo feels very disappointed. He feels betrayed by Jorge Jesus.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says Ronaldo’s hard-work persona created a cult-like fanbase but also made people around him wish for his downfall, including in Portugal.
quote: And that's the thing that's happening with the Portuguese team. It was fake love. They hated him.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali condemns the backlash against Ronaldo from Portuguese fans and reads social-media posts accusing him of narcissism and harming Portugal compared with Lionel Messi’s relationship with Argentina.
quote: Ronaldo has to treat Portugal like Messi treats Argentina.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano says people close to the camp describe an extremely tense situation, with Ronaldo wanting respect and Jorge Jesus insisting on authority, while Portugal publicly moved on with 24 players.
quote: Cristiano was not happy at all. He left the national team camp.

speaker: Dotun Adebayo
summary: The host reads Cristiano Ronaldo's statement saying he decided to leave Portugal camp after talks with the federation president and will explain his reasons later.
quote: In due time, I will tell all the Portuguese about the reasons that motivated my departure from the national team, which I always dedicated myself to.

speaker: Andy Brassell
summary: Brassell predicts the walkout will seriously damage Ronaldo's legacy and says it is hard to imagine any reasons that could justify his behaviour.
quote: I mean, whatever these reasons are, it's impossible to believe that they're going to be able to justify this sort of behavior, whatever he's been for Portugal and whatever he's done for Portugal.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says Ronaldo is no longer good enough for Portugal and predicts fans will eventually tell him it is time to step aside.
quote: He doesn't have it anymore.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali suggests Portugal may have promised Ronaldo starts to keep him for financial reasons, then benched him, prompting him to leave camp, which would shift blame to the federation.
quote: Maybe they lied to him.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano quotes Ronaldo saying he was willing to help Portugal from any role but would leave if he felt unwanted.
quote: If I feel they want me, if I feel they don't want me, anyone, the president, the coach, whoever, one day they don't want me, I grab my bag and I leave.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano reports Ronaldo’s camp says he will tell the truth later, while Ronaldo’s sister Elma publicly described the situation as a betrayal.
quote: The sister of Cristiano Ronaldo, Elma, speaking in public on his social media, speaks about betrayal, and so Cristiano feels betrayed.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says Jorge Jesus may have promised Ronaldo game time against Norway, made him warm up for 20 to 30 minutes, and then did not use him, which he says gave Ronaldo a right to feel disrespected.
quote: And at the end, he did not let Ronaldo end the game against Norway.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali criticizes Ronaldo’s reaction as a tantrum and argues that at 41 he should accept being benched and act as a leader for Portugal’s next generation.
quote: You're 41 years old. You should be okay with being on a bench even for an entire game.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says Ronaldo must accept being benched at 41 and reveals Ronaldo liked a post accusing Portugal of not treating him like Argentina treats Messi.
quote: Yes, Cristiano Ronaldo has liked this video saying that the Portuguese players did not treat him like the way that Argentinian players treated Lionel Messi.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says Portugal’s players hated Ronaldo because of his traits despite showing worse traits themselves, and challenges what they have done for the country.
quote: I feel like they hated Ronaldo because of his traits, right?

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali predicts that any meeting could end with Ronaldo receiving a final memorial match or a retirement date rather than a normal return to the national team.
quote: It should be let's have one more memorial match and call it a day or just set a date for a retirement.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano explains that Jorge Jesus defended leaving Ronaldo unused after a warm-up, saying even legends would be unhappy but he makes the decisions.
quote: Today, Jorge Jesus said even Pelé or Maradona would not be happy if they warmed up 20 minutes, 30 minutes, and then they don't play.

speaker: Andy Brassell
summary: Brassell says Ronaldo publicly accepted any role but apparently expected a bigger one, after Jorge Jesus chose not to bring him on despite previously indicating he might.
quote: He chose another option and he openly admitted that he'd said to Ronaldo that he was going to bring him on probably for the last 20 minutes.

speaker: Jonathan Johnson
summary: Johnson says Ronaldo appeared to bypass Jorge Jesus by going to the Portuguese federation president, forcing Portugal into a choice between coach and player.
quote: Do we stick with the coach or do we bring back the former talisman?

speaker: Jonathan Johnson
summary: Johnson says Ronaldo must be realistic about his age and recent Portugal output, suggesting he has sometimes held the team back.
quote: You could say at times, you know, he's been sort of a handbreak on this team.

speaker: Andy Brassell
summary: Andy Brassell says Portugal would look ridiculous if they removed Jorge Jesus over the Cristiano Ronaldo dispute.
quote: I mean, I don't see that happening, but that would make Portugal an absolute laughingstock.

speaker: Andy Brassell
summary: Andy Brassell argues Portugal's real decision may be about Cristiano Ronaldo rather than Jorge Jesus, despite Ronaldo's commercial importance.
quote: the decision is not about Jorge Jesus, but it's about Cristiano Ronaldo

speaker: Jonathan Johnson
summary: Jonathan Johnson says Ronaldo needs to accept reality and risks tarnishing the end of his Portugal career if he does not step aside.
quote: there is an element of Cristiano Ronaldo needing to accept reality.

speaker: Jonathan Johnson
summary: Jonathan Johnson says Jesus' blunt stance on only playing Ronaldo when needed may have been taken as disrespectful, but Ronaldo still appears focused on himself.
quote: ultimately Ronaldo is going to continue to put himself first.

speaker: Jonathan Johnson
summary: The speaker argues Ronaldo must accept that his Portugal role can no longer be talismanic and warns the situation is becoming toxic.
quote: It constantly gets turned into, you know, the Cristiano Ronaldo show when it doesn't need to be.

speaker: Dotun Adebayo
summary: The speaker says Ronaldo should accept a reduced role with Portugal because his on-pitch case has become indefensible.
quote: But in terms of on pitch, it's it's it's been indefensible for a while.

speaker: Dotun Adebayo
summary: The speaker defends Jorge Jesus's handling of Ronaldo and says the Portuguese public will likely side with the coach because Ronaldo has long been an issue for the national team.
quote: Ronaldo as a player being an issue that's hung over the Portuguese national team for a long time really.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says Ronaldo reacted angrily to being benched for 90 minutes against Norway and went straight down the tunnel without applauding fans.
quote: He got benched for the full 90 minutes for the first time since 2008, and he took offense to that.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says Ronaldo should have ended his Portugal career after the World Cup defeat to Spain.
quote: Cristiano Ronaldo should retire or should have retired and hung up his boots after the World Cup.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali calls Ronaldo’s post-Norway behavior a tantrum and says it disrespected Portugal.
quote: He threw a tantrum after the Norway game.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says Ronaldo disrespected fans by going straight down the tunnel after the Norway game and is creating tension at age 43 under Jorge Jesus.
quote: You're still creating tension even after we have a manager that is finally good enough.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali speculates that Portugal’s federation wanted Ronaldo to stay because his departure would hurt followers, ticket sales, merchandise and revenue.
quote: Portugal will most likely fall off.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: The commentator defends Portugal’s manager for benching Ronaldo and argues that no player, regardless of status, should dictate the team’s decisions.
quote: Because he is finally pulling the trigger of benching Cristiano Ronaldo.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano says Ronaldo became furious after warming up for 30 minutes against Norway and then not playing at all, while Jorge Jesus admitted any player would be angry.
quote: Cristiano Ronaldo doesn't start and that's not the problem, but then when Cristiano has to warm up, 30 minutes warming up and then not playing one single minute.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano says Jorge Jesus is insisting he remains in total control and will explain the Ronaldo situation only after Portugal’s final game.
quote: Cristiano is a symbol. Cristiano is an icon. No one can take that away from him.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says Ronaldo is still a great athlete but his body is giving out, and argues Portugal needed a player like Gonçalo Ramos against Norway because he presses and tracks back.
quote: But at the same time, man, the way he moves on the pitch now, it just his body just gives out, man.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali questions why Portugal’s players, fans and managers do not protect Ronaldo the way Argentina protects Lionel Messi.
quote: But why do they not treat him, the players, the fans, the managers?

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali argues Ronaldo’s greatness came from his passion and arrogance, but says that same personality makes people see him as cocky.
quote: The reason Cristiano Ronaldo became Cristiano Ronaldo is because of his passion, his arrogance, he's loud, he's always like a show off, but in a good way.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says the criticism of Ronaldo has gone too far and defends him by arguing that his achievements on the pitch are what should matter most.
quote: But like I said, man, I think the disrespect is getting a bit too much.

speaker: Andy Brassell
summary: Brassell says Jesus' post-match press conference hardened Ronaldo's feelings because the coach made clear Gonzalo Ramos would start the next game unless something went wrong.
quote: Unless something goes really wrong in training Gonzalo Ramos is going to start.

speaker: Andy Brassell
summary: Brassell says Jorge Jesus controlled the press conference by limiting Ronaldo questions and stressing that Portugal could not keep operating this way.
quote: He said at the top, "Look, I'm only going to ask answer two questions about Cristiano because we can't go on like this."

speaker: Andy Brassell
summary: Brassell says Jesus had already told Ronaldo he would only play in games one and four, so Ronaldo’s anger at not coming on is unjustified.
quote: The the only thing that he's really done that Ronaldo could have been upset about is that he didn't bring him on in this game.

speaker: Andy Brassell
summary: Andy Brassell compares Jorge Jesus' handling of Cristiano Ronaldo to his blunt treatment of Neymar, saying Jesus was proved right after dropping Neymar in Saudi Arabia.
quote: I said to Neymar finish in English which is brutal

speaker: Dotun Adebayo
summary: The speaker says Ronaldo went down the tunnel after Portugal's win in Norway, then had a seemingly positive discussion with Jorge Jesus before the press conference reignited the issue.
quote: After Ronaldo went straight down the tunnel and didn't celebrate with the rest of the team and the fans after they won in Norway, there was a discussion between Jesus and Cristiano Ronaldo and it apparently went quite well.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali criticizes Ronaldo fans who still want him to play future tournaments and says true fans should tell him to retire.
quote: Age has unfortunately caught up to you.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali argues Ronaldo owed Portugal fans applause after the win because they paid expensive tickets to see him.
quote: Go and applaud the fans, Cristiano Ronaldo.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali defends Ronaldo’s legacy, arguing he put Portugal on the football map and that Portuguese criticism of him is somewhat disrespectful.
quote: Cristiano Ronaldo put Portugal on the map.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali argues that Portuguese fans have the right to criticize Ronaldo because national-team football belongs to them, not to Ronaldo’s global fanbase.
quote: So, Ronaldo fans, you need to go easy on Portuguese people because if you take their side of the story, they have the right to say everything they have been saying.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano explains that Ronaldo had considered retiring from international football after the World Cup but continued partly because Jorge Jesus became Portugal coach.
quote: Then Cristiano decided to continue also because a coach he knows very well, Jorge Jesus, they won together at Al Nassr last season was becoming the new coach of the Portuguese national team.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano says Ronaldo’s next move and Jorge Jesus’s future comments remain uncertain, while some Portugal players close to Ronaldo are affected by the dressing-room tension.
quote: Obviously, it's a difficult situation also for some of the players in the dressing room who share a personal great relationship with Cristiano.

speaker: Andy Brassell
summary: Andy Brassell argues the saga highlights both the best and worst of Ronaldo, whose dedication to Portugal is unquestioned despite his individualist reputation.
quote: I guess really if we look at that that sort of frames both the best of Ronaldo and the worst of Ronaldo.

speaker: JJ Bull
summary: JJ Bull says Portugal’s win over Norway has been overshadowed by the fallout that followed, despite Gonzalo Ramos scoring.
quote: But I think it's it's just a shame really that ultimately the the actual game itself has been overshadowed by by what followed.

speaker: Coach Ali
summary: Coach Ali says deeply invested Portugal supporters have the right to call out Ronaldo if he is creating problems while other players perform well.
quote: They have the right to say and call out Cristiano Ronaldo.

speaker: Fabrizio Romano
summary: Romano says Bruno Fernandes is now Portugal captain while Rafael Leão received Cristiano Ronaldo’s number seven shirt, but stresses Leão did not ask for it.
quote: Rafael Leão, from what I'm told, didn't ask for the number seven shirt.
